name: Vegetable Recognition
description: The Vegetable Recognition dataset is a small image classification benchmark where each sample contains an image of a vegetable and a text prompt asking the model to identify its category. It evaluates visual object recognition and multiclass classification of vegetables.
card_text: This dataset contains 240 samples of vegetable images paired with a short instruction prompt. The input is an image file (e.g., images/1032.jpg) and a text prompt: 'Recognize the category of the vegetable'. The model must output the correct vegetable name (e.g., Broccoli, Pumpkin) as a text label. The dataset is an open-set multiclass classification task focused on everyday vegetables. Images are likely simple, centered on a single vegetable object. The text is minimal: a fixed instruction and a single-word output. It tests basic object recognition and fine-grained category identification. No additional context, bounding boxes, or multiple-choice options are provided.

image.semantics: An image file containing a single vegetable (or a simple scene focused on the vegetable) to be recognized.

question.semantics: Instruction prompt asking the model to recognize the category of the vegetable shown in the image.

answer.semantics: The vegetable category name (e.g., Broccoli, Pumpkin) that serves as the classification label for the given image.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample consists of an image file path, a fixed text instruction prompt, and a short text answer. The image provides the visual input of a vegetable; the prompt asks the model to recognize its category; the answer gives the corresponding vegetable name. No dialog, options, bounding boxes, masks, or additional context fields are present.
